decisions: Spec ratified at FR-001..FR-189 / SC-001..SC-017 (contiguous, verified programmatically) over 5 LEX crew review cycles.
FR-189: structural depth + per-parent degree guard.
FR-185: wordform on roster; writing systems excluded.

Corpus selection ranges over three orthogonal axes (class presence, writing-system breadth, structural depth); Yi Sichuan must be retained -- only project of 84 with nested reversals and widest WS spread, which presence-only greedy set-cover discards.
Fullsweep driver skeleton exists (Groups A/B/C/D/K/L), comparator pluggable.
Coverage limit: appendix, stratum, and one rule subclass exist in no project on this machine -- must report NOT-EVALUATED, never clean.
Open caveat: FLExToolsMCP was unavailable to lex-domain in 3 of 5 cycles; identity rulings rest on documented LCM semantics with live-check points flagged in reviews/cycle5-domain-identity.md.

decisions.decision: Grow debug/run_fullcopy_sweep.py into a tracked package debug/fullsweep/, keeping the file as a thin CLI entry point
decisions.why: FR-149/S-64 make trackedness a correctness property; debug/ is already tracked, already on the sys.path bootstrap, and already hosts the two modules the skeleton imports, so the move costs no import rewiring and leaves the shipped Lib/ surface untouched
decisions.rejected: src/gramtrans/Lib/fullsweep/ (would enlarge the shipped FlexTools artifact and blur Principle II) and a new top-level tools/ (new bootstrap, no benefit)

decisions.decision: Drive the generic field census off flexicon GetSyncableProperties, publishing the per-class omitted-property set on every artifact
decisions.why: It is the surface ApplySyncableProperties writes back, so the census measures exactly what the transfer moves; cost is settled at ~2500 field reads in ~0.1s; FR-066 already presumes an introspective surface with a publishable omitted set
decisions.rejected: LCM metadata reflection via IFwMetaDataCache (reaches fields the engine cannot write, so every one would report as permanent loss, and it reads LibLCM directly which Principle II forbids) and a hand-maintained per-class field list (the banned hand-picked set)

decisions.decision: Publish a severity ordering for the 10 verdicts that is independent of the exit-code integer, ranking untrustworthy-measurement verdicts above trustworthy-bad-result ones
decisions.why: FR-113 aggregates the corpus status as the single most severe verdict; sorting by exit code would rank UNEXPLAINED_LOSS (1) above HARNESS_ERROR (5) and send an operator chasing a loss figure a broken instrument produced
decisions.rejected: Reusing the exit code as the severity key, and a single non-zero exit for every failure (FR-111/FR-112 forbid it; it is the DROPS_REPORTED collapse the feature exists to retire)

decisions.decision: Corpus selection retains each axis MEASURED maximum carrier rather than naming projects; the three axes are added to prescan_type_coverage.py output
decisions.why: FR-192 forbids asserting axis values from project names, sizes, layout, or prior belief, so a rule pinning Yi Sichuan by name would violate the requirement it is meant to satisfy; the measured-maximum rule retains Yi Sichuan today and its successor tomorrow
decisions.rejected: A new standalone survey tool (would duplicate the read-only opening discipline that took a cycle to get right) and deriving depth from .fwdata XML without opening the project

decisions.decision: Split artifact storage: rosters/allowlist/fingerprint/ledger/negative-controls tracked under specs/035-fullsweep-fidelity/; per-run result artifacts and logs untracked under scratchpad/035_sweep/
decisions.why: FR-149 names exactly what must be version-controlled and does not include every per-run result; committing 82 result JSONs per batch would make the spec folder unreviewable while the ledger already carries each project durable standing and revision pair
decisions.rejected: Tracking everything, and tracking nothing (reintroduces S-64 for the rosters and makes the allowlist unreviewable)

decisions.decision: Delete reopen_and_count/_COUNT_ACCESSORS/total_count from tests/integration/harness/full_run.py and make build_full_selection exclude set an explicit required argument
decisions.why: Those three symbols carry five silence rows at once (S-50 dead accessor, S-51 laundered failure, S-52 three accessors for ~28 categories, S-53, S-59 meaningless heterogeneous sum); repairing them would leave a second counting mechanism beside the class inventory, and two counting mechanisms is how the disagreements got hidden
decisions.rejected: Fixing the accessors in place, and calling preview/transfer directly from the sweep instead of through the harness

approach: Grow the tracked skeleton debug/run_fullcopy_sweep.py (commit 8c72bdc) into a package debug/fullsweep/, adding the field comparator, the 15-guard registry, the 10-verdict model, the loss allowlist, the capability preflight, the coverage floor, negative controls, identity substitution, and the three-axis corpus survey. The sweep drives the shipped engine through the existing Lib/preview.py + Lib/transfer.py split via tests/integration/harness/full_run.py, and reads fields generically through flexicon's native GetSyncableProperties surface. Six phases: taxonomy spine, measurement core, gates, survey/selection, negative controls, then the batched live corpus run.

plan.summary: Plan + research + data-model + 7 contracts for the fullsweep: 6 phases growing the tracked 8c72bdc skeleton into debug/fullsweep/, all 65 anti-silence rows satisfied with zero waivers, Constitution v8.0.0 check 5/5 PASS.
plan.key_finding: FLExToolsMCP is reachable again (server 2.9.1, flexicon 4.3.1 exact-match index, LibLCM 11.0.0), so the cycle5 identity rulings that rested on documented LCM semantics become a schedulable live-verification task rather than a standing caveat -- and the constitution in this tree is v8.0.0, not the v5.1.0 the brief cited.
